subject: Next steps: CloudGateway marketplace vendor PO intake & bank info
messages:

Subject: Marketplace onboarding — vendor packet & PO routing

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week — excited to get CloudGateway listed on Redwood's marketplace. I've attached our vendor packet for intake (CloudGateway_vendor_packet.zip) but wanted to clarify your PO and billing path so we can loop in our AP team.

Questions:
- What exact vendor forms do you need from us to open a PO? (W9 / tax attestation / bank info)
- Who should we list as the Redwood PO contact and what is the preferred PO template?
- Any special remittance or invoice instructions for marketplace transactions?

We're planning a go-live week of Oct 18 and would like PO in place by Oct 8.

Attaching: CloudGateway_vendor_packet.zip (contains corporate profile, insurance cert, sample invoice)

Thanks —
Maria Lopez
Head of Partnerships | CloudGateway
maria@cloudgateway.io
+1 415-555-0142
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — vendor packet & PO routing

Hi Maria — great to hear, and glad the demo was useful. Welcome aboard.

Summary of what we'll need to open a PO on our side:
- Completed vendor intake form (attached) — vendor_intake_form.pdf
- Signed tax docs: W-9 for US entities or local tax attestation if outside US
- Bank details (voided check or bank_details_redacted.pdf) for ACH setup
- Certificate of insurance (you mentioned that's in your packet)

I've attached our PO template as well: PO_template_CloudGateway.docx. Please populate the intake form and return the bank details + W-9 to me. Copy procurement@cloudgateway.io as needed.

Logistics / timing:
- If we receive completed forms and bank info by Oct 6, finance can issue PO by Oct 8.
- Standard Redwood terms for marketplace sellers are Net 60 unless we agreed otherwise in the contract; Ben in Finance will confirm.

CC'ing Vanessa (Marketplace Ops) to coordinate intake and Lauren (Legal ops) for any legal checks. Vanessa — can you confirm whether we need additional evidence for the marketplace listing (SLA addendum / data processing addendum) for CloudGateway?

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf, PO_template_CloudGateway.docx

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — vendor packet & PO routing

Neha / Ben — quick internal note before we send the formal checklist back to CloudGateway:

- CloudGateway is listed as US entity in their packet, so W-9 is sufficient; request vendor_tax_attestation.pdf if there are overseas subsidiaries.
- For marketplace listings we require: intake form, COI, W-9, bank details. If the product accesses customer data, we also need a signed DPA — Lauren, any flags?
- Finance needs billing entity (legal name + address) to map to our vendor master. Maria, please confirm the exact pay-to entity in the intake form.

Ben — when you have a sec, can you pre-author a PO number range we can assign to marketplace sellers this quarter? We typically prefer Net 60 for new marketplace partners; request exception only if partner negotiates.

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Lopez <maria@cloudgateway.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: James Murray <james.murray@cloudgateway.io>, procurement@cloudgateway.io
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:41:00 -07:00

Hi Neha / Vanessa — attaching the completed intake items per your checklist.

What I'm sending now:
- vendor_intake_form.pdf (filled)
- vendor_w9.pdf (signed)
- bank_details_redacted.pdf (ACH routing + last 4 digits)

Pay-to entity is: CloudGateway, Inc.; remit address is on page 2 of the intake form. James Murray (cc'd) will handle AP and will be the invoice contact going forward (james.murray@cloudgateway.io).

We understand Net 60; please advise if Redwood requires a different vendor setup for marketplace revenue share payouts vs. direct vendor invoices. We aim to be flexible.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf, vendor_w9.pdf, bank_details_redacted.pdf

Thanks,
Maria
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Maria Lopez <maria@cloudgateway.io>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: PO issued: PO_000472 / payment terms confirmed

Hi all — quick update from Finance.

- PO number PO_000472 has been created and attached for CloudGateway, Inc. (see PO_000472_CloudGateway.pdf).
- Vendor master updated with legal name and remit address from the intake form.
- Payment terms: Net 60 (standard). If CloudGateway would like accelerated payment (Net 30), we can evaluate for a processing fee — Maria, let us know if you want us to run that.
- ACH setup pending final bank verification (we received bank_details_redacted.pdf). Once micro-deposits clear, payments will flow to the account on file.

Next steps:
1) Neha/Vanessa — confirm marketplace listing date (requested Oct 18).
2) Maria/James — confirm acceptance of PO_000472 and return signed PO if required by your AP process.
3) Finance will schedule the first payout run once micro-deposits are verified (typically 3 business days).

Attachment: PO_000472_CloudGateway.pdf

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Finance | Redwood Inference
